<!-- Open, hands-on problem-solving session: participants bring a problem of their
     own and the instructors help formulate and solve it. Best-effort, no guarantees. -->

::: callout-note
## Goal
Take a problem of your own --- from your research, your work, or plain curiosity ---
and try to express and solve it with CVXR, with the instructors on hand to help.
:::

This is an open, hands-on session. Bring a problem you care about: a model you are
stuck on, an optimization buried somewhere in your own field, or just an idea you want
to see whether CVXR can express. We will work through it together using the modeling
vocabulary from the earlier chapters --- variables, objective, constraints, and the
DCP rules --- and try to get to a solve.
